subject: Flightdeck sync: timeline, hazards, and go/no-go windows
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Flightdeck sync: timeline, hazards, and go/no-go windows

Team —

Thanks for carving out time. With QBR in two weeks I want a concise snapshot we can present to execs that shows: roadmap status, any slippage on launch timelines, and the top 5 delivery risks with mitigations. High-level constraints: SLA gating, infra readiness, partner integration, and any customer-facing regressions.

Please use the attached hazard_matrix_template.xlsx and return a one-slide summary + the completed matrix by EOD Monday. Specific asks:  
- Rishi: engine & infra readiness numbers (capacity, queue depth, kv-cache warm rate) + any known perf risks
- Laura: release windows, staging freeze dates, and preflight checklist status
- Tessa/Marcus: customer integration readiness & open items with Astra (if any)

I want a single consolidated artifact I can run in the exec pack — keep bullets short. I'll compile and send a pre-read to the leadership thread on Tuesday morning.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Flightdeck sync: timeline, hazards, and go/no-go windows

Eve — quick status from infra/serving side. Inline to keep trace: 

> Rishi: engine & infra readiness numbers (capacity, queue depth, kv-cache warm rate) + any known perf risks

Status (short):
- Capacity: Dedicated pool projected at 82% of target for week-of-launch due to one delayed node procurement (ETA 2 weeks). Impact: throughput headroom reduced; mitigation: enable burst lanes and conservative rate-limiter for non-critical routes.
- Queue depth: nominal at 18ms p50, 120ms p95 in staging; p95 spikes tied to cold-starts when KV cache is empty.
- KV-cache warm: baseline warm rate 72% after 15s of steady traffic; optimization patch (small change) improves to ~92% but needs final infra rollout. Plan to Canary patch next Tue.
- Perf risks: quantization regression on variant-v3 under long-context cases; mitigation: fallback to variant-v2 for >4k tokens.

Attachments: none here — I'll update the hazard matrix and attach the serving section. Also looping in Marja from Astra on integration delay (see below).

Thanks — Rishi
--

Eve / Rishi — short release and schedule update.

Summary:
- Release windows: Target prod cut: 2026-07-02 to 2026-07-05 (three-day window). Staging freeze planned 2026-06-29.
- Canary plan: two-week canary starting 2026-07-06 (region-by-region).
- Preflight checklist: 85% complete — outstanding items are: load test sign-off, DB schema migration dry-run, and third-party cert renewals.

Risks (top):
1) Node procurement delay (Rishi): reduces burst capacity — contingency: enable reserved burst and postpone low-priority batch lanes.
2) Astra integration lag: partner may require extra testing that shifts one integration cutover by 2 weeks (Marja copied below).
3) Schema migration edge-case: potential for 1–2 hour maintenance window if migration hits legacy rows — mitigation: incremental migration + backfill script.

I've uploaded an updated timeline CSV (launch_timeline_v2.csv) and started the flightdeck_hazard_matrix.xlsx with my release items. Will update with action owners.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Release Management
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, Marja Lee <marja@astra.health>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Flightdeck sync: timeline, hazards, and go/no-go windows

Thanks for the fast turn. Consolidated notes and decisions for the exec pre-read: 

Action items (owners / due):
- Rishi: Canary the KV warm-rate patch in staging by Tue 2026-06-16; confirm p95 improvements and drop-in rollback plan (due 6/17).
- Laura: Finalize preflight checklist and confirm load-test sign-off by 6/25. Upload go/no-go slide to Drive (done).
- Tessa/Marcus: Outreach to Astra and confirm integration cutover acceptance matrix; if Astra needs +2w, we will present the mitigated timeline (due 6/18).
- Evelyn: I will fold these into the flightdeck_hazard_matrix.xlsx and produce a single slide for execs by 6/16 10:00AM.

Decision notes to call out in the QBR:
- We will preserve the primary launch window (2026-07-02) but mark Astra's integration as a customer-dependent slip; show dual-track canary (fast-fail for non-integrated customers).
- If node procurement slips beyond 2 weeks, we will convert one high-throughput lane to a reserved paid lane to preserve SLAs.

Marja — thanks for the quick alignment earlier. If you can confirm the integration test cadence and whether a 2-week buffer is required, we will reflect that in the exec slide.

Attachments: flightdeck_hazard_matrix.xlsx (consolidated draft), exec_slide_pre-read.pdf (placeholder)

Evelyn
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
